conf.description: z/OS RACF command audit, IRRADU00 SMF-80 unload (dataset=racf-command, format=other): fixed-width positional extraction of the 280-byte common header plus the PERMIT/ADDSD/ALTDSD/ALTUSER/CONNECT/RDEFINE/SETROPTS extensions, ID()/ACCESS() sub-parse on PERMIT, map to ECS + racf.* custom fields.

conf.comment: RACF command audit, IRRADU00 unload (dataset=racf-command, format=other). No Elastic integration/Cribl pack for this layout; hand-built per recommendations.direct.cribl. Byte positions are from IBM 'z/OS Security Server RACF Macros and Interfaces' SA23-2288-03, Chapter 6 (Table 6 common header; Tables 22/28/32/34/44/48/54 for the ADDSD/ALTDSD/ALTUSER/CONNECT/PERMIT/RDEFINE/SETROPTS extensions), fetched 2026-09-17 - not guessed. A single code() step does fixed-width substring extraction (1-indexed inclusive positions per the manual) since 7 different extension layouts branch on EVENT_TYPE; unrecognized event codes fall through with only the common header populated, per the recommendation's explicit unknown-command fallback.

conf.code: var L=_raw||''; function fx(s,e){return L.substring(s-1,e).replace(/\s+$/,'');} var et=fx(1,8),eq=fx(10,17),vio=fx(44,47),tw=fx(19,26),dw=fx(28,37),smfid=fx(39,42),euid=fx(59,66),egid=fx(68,75),la=fx(142,145),lc=fx(147,150),ls=fx(127,130),lg=fx(152,155),term=fx(171,178); var cls=null,own=null,uname=null,resn=null,dsn=null,secl=null,secll=null,spec=null,fail=null,ign=null; if(et==='PERMIT'){cls=fx(282,289);own=fx(291,298);uname=fx(300,319);resn=fx(503,757);spec=fx(759,1782);fail=fx(1784,2807);ign=fx(2809,3832);} else if(et==='ADDSD'){own=fx(282,289);uname=fx(291,310);secl=fx(312,319);secll=fx(503,518);dsn=fx(520,563);spec=fx(565,1588);fail=fx(1590,2613);} else if(et==='ALTDSD'){own=fx(282,289);uname=fx(291,310);secl=fx(312,319);secll=fx(503,518);dsn=fx(520,563);spec=fx(565,1588);fail=fx(1590,2613);ign=fx(2615,3638);} else if(et==='ALTUSER'){own=fx(282,289);uname=fx(291,310);spec=fx(527,1550);fail=fx(1552,2575);ign=fx(2577,3600);} else if(et==='CONNECT'){own=fx(282,289);uname=fx(291,310);spec=fx(503,1526);fail=fx(1528,2551);} else if(et==='RDEFINE'){cls=fx(282,289);own=fx(291,298);uname=fx(300,319);resn=fx(512,766);spec=fx(768,1791);fail=fx(1793,2816);} else if(et==='SETROPTS'){uname=fx(282,301);spec=fx(485,1508);fail=fx(1510,2533);} var idm=spec?spec.match(/ID\(([^)]*)\)/):null; var am=spec?spec.match(/ACCESS\(([^)]*)\)/):null; __e['event.action']=et; __e['event.reason']=eq; __e['event.outcome']=vio==='YES'?'failure':(vio==='NO'?'success':'unknown'); __e['host.name']=smfid; __e['user.name']=euid; __e['user.group.name']=egid; if(uname)__e['user.full_name']=uname; if(idm)__e['user.target.name']=idm[1]; if(am)__e['racf.command.granted_access']=am[1]; if(cls)__e['racf.resource.class']=cls; if(own)__e['racf.profile.owner']=own; if(resn)__e['racf.resource.name']=resn; if(dsn)__e['file.path']=dsn; if(secl)__e['racf.seclabel.profile']=secl; if(secll)__e['racf.seclabel.link']=secll; if(spec)__e['racf.command.specified']=spec; if(fail)__e['racf.command.failed']=fail; if(ign)__e['racf.command.ignored']=ign; if(term)__e['racf.terminal']=term; var lr=[]; if(la==='YES')lr.push('always'); if(lc==='YES')lr.push('cmdviol'); if(ls==='YES')lr.push('special'); if(lg==='YES')lr.push('global'); __e['racf.log_reason']=lr; var ep=Date.parse(dw+'T'+tw+'Z'); _time=isNaN(ep)?_time:ep/1000; __e['event.dataset']='zos_racf.command';

functions.description: Fixed-width extraction of the common header (positions 1-280) plus the per-command extension (from position 282), branched on EVENT_TYPE; sub-parse ID()/ACCESS() out of the PERMIT keyword blob (fails soft to null, per IBM's own disclaimer that keyword order/format is not part of the programming interface); map to ECS + racf.* custom fields; unrecognized EVENT_TYPE values keep the common header only

conf.comment: LPAR UTC offset for _time is NOT applied - the work order's transform says to apply it but the offset is site-specific and not given anywhere in this work order, so DATE_WRITTEN+TIME_WRITTEN is treated as UTC. Documented gap: a real deployment must supply the LPAR's offset.
